corrections: 【承重修正·分母】"N=2,743" → 2,743 是**收到 BDM 报价的人数**,不是分析样本。三级口径必须分清:2,897 人"had valid baseline and were randomized"(进入报价随机化);2,743 人"received a price offer";真正估计所有处理效应的"impact evaluation sample"是 **N=1,661**(Treatment 580 / Control 1,081),完成 endline 的 1,637,post-endline 手机用量仅 1,219。含 0.09 SD 在内的全部因果估计建立在 ~1,661/1,637 上,而非 2,743。用 N=2,743 描述该实验的效应量样本,把分析样本夸大约 65%。(AER 2020 Table 1 Sample Sizes;Table 3 Observations 580/1,081)

【承重修正·分子分母倒置】"WTA<$102 的 61% 被随机化" → 方向反了。原文逐字:"We then randomly assigned the 61 percent of these subjects with WTA less than $102 to either a Treatment group that was paid to deactivate, or a Control group that was not." 即 **2,743 人中有 61% 的人 WTA<$102**(1,661/2,743 = 60.6% ≈ 61%),这 61% 构成被分入处理/对照的样本;并非"WTA<$102 的人里有 61% 被随机化"。

【构念修正·估计量】0.09 SD 未标注估计量类型 → 它是 **LATE / IV 估计**(local average treatment effect),不是 ITT。论文按 randomized encouragement design 分析:价格报价 p 先随机分配(约 33% 得 $102、67% 得 $0、0.2% 从 [0,170] 均匀抽取),"impact evaluation sample"是 (WTA<$102) ∩ (被分到 $102 或 $0) 的交集,再用 IV 估计。预分析计划 2018-11-07 修订版明确改为"use IV estimates instead of intent-to-treat estimates"。ITT 会小于 0.09。引用时应写作"停用 Facebook 对依从者的 LATE 为 0.09 SD"。

【精度修正】"合规>90%" → 这是论文引言的原话("the Treatment group's compliance with deactivation exceeded 90 percent"),逐字成立;但底层测量值恰为 **0.90**:Table 3 "Share days deactivated" Treatment = 0.90 (SD 0.29)、Control = 0.02 (SD 0.13);正文 Section 3 作"deactivated on 90 percent of checks between October 13 and November 7"。严格说是"约 90%"而非">90%";且合规是按公开主页 ping 的"检查次数占比"定义,不是账号级二元合规率。

【构念修正·对照基准被读大】引言的 "psychological interventions" → 正文 Section 5.3 的准确表述是 "**positive** psychology interventions (i.e., self-help therapy, group training, and individual therapy)"。Bolier 2013 是**积极心理学干预**的元分析,不是临床心理治疗/抗抑郁治疗。用引言的简称"心理干预"转述,易被读成"相当于看心理医生效果的 25-40%",属过度解读。

【口径补注·25-40% 的分母是选出来的】25-40% = 0.09/0.34(主观幸福感)至 0.09/0.23(抑郁)。Bolier 2013 实际报告**三个**构念:subjective well-being d=0.34、psychological well-being d=**0.20**、depression d=0.23。论文只取了 0.34 与 0.23 两个;若纳入 0.20,区间上沿为 0.09/0.20 = **45%**。另:Bolier 作者自陈"Indications for publication bias were found for all outcome measures"、39 项研究中 20 项质量评级为低且无一满足全部质量标准、多数为 completers-only 分析——分母很可能被高估,故 25-40% 若有偏差是偏**保守**(实际相对比值可能更高)。

【版本注】claim 标注为 AER 2020,但所给 URL(web.stanford.edu/~gentzkow/research/facebook.pdf)实际提供的是 **2019-11-08 工作论文版**。我已对两版逐字比对:(a)(b)(c) 的全部数字与措辞在工作论文版与 AER published 版(110(3): 629-676, DOI 10.1257/aer.20190658)**完全一致**,故不影响结论。唯一排印差异:印刷版为 en dash "25–40 percent",claim 写作连字符 "25-40"。

【样本代表性补注】(d)"成人样本非青少年"成立,但需附代表性警告。入选条件逐字为 "a US resident born between the years 1900 and 2000 who uses Facebook more than 15 minutes and no more than 600 minutes per day",年龄下限约 18 岁,确无未成年人。但样本经 Facebook 广告自选择 + WTA<$102 二次筛选,严重偏斜(Table 2):**52% 年龄<30**(Facebook 用户 26%、美国人口 21%)、**51% 大学学历**(美国 29%)、日均 Facebook **74.5 分钟**(普通用户 45 分钟)。即:是成年人,但是"偏年轻、偏高学历、偏重度用户"的成年人;且研究对象是 2018 年的 **Facebook**,不涉及青少年、不涉及 Instagram/TikTok。用于"青少年屏幕时间"议题时只能作为成人类比证据,不能外推到青少年。
evidence_notes: 【一手·出版版全文】gwern.net 镜像的印刷版 PDF(https://gwern.net/doc/sociology/technology/2020-allcott.pdf),经 pdftotext 提取确认页眉 "VOL. 110 NO. 3 ALLCOTT ET AL.: THE WELFARE EFFECTS OF SOCIAL MEDIA"、"MARCH 2020"、页码 629-676、DOI 10.1257/aer.20190658。(b)(c) 引语在此版逐字命中。

【(b) 逐字核对·PASS】印刷版原文:"Our overall index of subjective well-being improved by 0.09 standard deviations. As a point of comparison, this is about 25–40 percent of the effect of psychological interventions including self-help therapy, group training, and individual therapy, as reported in a meta-analysis by Bolier et al. (2013)." claim 的省略号恰好压缩了 "As a point of comparison, this is",引语忠实。

【(c) 逐字核对·PASS】印刷版原文:"However, we also show that the magnitudes of our causal effects are far smaller than those we would have estimated using the correlational approach of much prior literature." claim 截断于 "correlational approach" 之前,未改变语义。支撑数字(Section 5.3):"The baseline correlation between our SWB index and Facebook use is about three times larger than the experimental estimate of the treatment effect of deactivation (about 0.23 SD compared to 0.09 SD), and the point estimates are highly statistically significantly different."

【0.09 SD 的构成】Section 5.3 分项:life satisfaction 0.12 SD、anxiety 0.10 SD、depression 0.09 SD、happiness 0.08 SD,"All of these effects remain significant after adjusting for multiple hypothesis testing";短信测量的 happiness 不显著(0.01-0.06 SD)。综合指数 0.09 SD(工作论文附录表:估计 0.09、SE 0.04、p 0.02、q 0.03)。原始单位:happiness 对照组均值 4.47/7、增加 0.12;life satisfaction 12.26/21、增加 0.56。

【Bolier 2013 一手核对·PASS】PMC3599475(BMC Public Health 13:119)确认:39 项随机对照研究(40 篇文章)、6,139 名被试;post-test 效应量 subjective well-being d=0.34 (95% CI 0.22-0.45)、psychological well-being d=0.20 (0.09-0.30)、depression d=0.23 (0.09-0.38)。故 Allcott 引用的 0.34 与 0.23 准确,25-40% 的算术成立(0.09/0.34=26.5%,0.09/0.23=39.1%)。作者自陈警告:"Indications for publication bias were found for all outcome measures";"The quality of the studies was not high, and no study met all of our quality criteria"(20 项评为低质量)。

【(d) 注册号一手核对·PASS】socialscienceregistry.org/trials/3409 确认 AEARCTR-0003409,题为 "Evaluating Social Media",PI 为 Allcott(NYU)、Braghieri/Eichmeyer/Gentzkow(Stanford)及 Raj Bhargava,注册日 2018-10-11,干预期 2018-10-11 至 2018-12-06,计划样本 3,051。论文脚注亦逐字载明 "This RCT was registered in the American Economic Association Registry for randomized control trials under trial number AEARCTR-0003409",并称预分析计划于 10 月 12 日提交、11 月 7 日提交小幅修订版。
【勘误检索·无】AEA 官方文章页(https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257/aer.20190658)未列出任何 erratum / correction / corrigendum / comment-reply。截至 2026-07-27 未见撤稿或更正。

【时长与设计·PASS】"四周"成立:摘要 "deactivating Facebook for the four weeks before the 2018 US midterm election";BDM 机制询问的是"stay deactivated for four weeks rather than 24 hours";midline→endline 为 weeks 1-4,endline 后另有 weeks 5-8 的第二次 BDM。$102 阈值的选取理由逐字:"We chose $102 because our pilot data correctly suggested that there would be a point mass of WTAs at $100."

【利益相关性核查·未见被研究方资助】披露栏逐字:"Allcott is a paid employee of Microsoft Research. Gentzkow does paid consulting work for Amazon and is a member of the Toulouse Network for Information Technology, a research group funded by Microsoft. Braghieri and Eichmeyer have no relevant or material disclosures." 资助方为 Sloan Foundation 与 Knight Foundation——**无 Facebook/Meta 资助**,不存在"被研究平台买单"的直接利益冲突。致谢中出现数位 Facebook 研究人员(Nancy Baym、Moira Burke、Annie Franco、Alex Leavitt),但属评论致谢而非资助。IRB:Stanford eProtocol #45403、NYU IRB-FY2018-2139。

【招募漏斗完整链条】1,892,191 人看到广告 → 32,201 点击(1.7% CTR)→ 22,324 完成预筛 → 20,959 为美国居民且生于 1900-2000 → 17,335 日均 Facebook 使用 15-600 分钟 → 7,455 同意参与 → 3,910 完成 baseline → 2,897 有效并被随机化 → 2,743 收到报价 → 1,661 进入影响评估样本。自选择层层收窄,是外部效度的主要限制。

corrections: 【分析样本 N】修正前:"N=2,743" 作为实验规模。修正后:2,743 是**收到 BDM 报价的人数**,不是效应估计的样本。Figure 1 流程:1,892,191 看到广告 → 32,201 点击 → 7,455 同意 → 3,910 完成 baseline → 2,897 有效并被随机化 → 2,743 收到报价 → **N=1,661 进入 impact evaluation sample**(endline 1,637;post-endline 1,219)。Table 3 显示 Treatment 580 / Control 1,081 = 1,661。0.09 SD 是在 ~1,637 上估的,不是 2,743。引 "N=2,743" 忠于论文自己的摘要措辞("We recruited a sample of 2,743 users"),但比真实分析 N 高出约 65%。

【随机化机制顺序】修正前:"WTA<$102 的 61% 被随机化"(暗示先筛 WTA 再随机化)。修正后:实际顺序相反。Section 2.2:2,897 名有效 baseline 者**先**被随机分配到报价组(p=$102 约 33%、p=$0 约 67%、p~U[0,$170] 约 0.2%,在 48 个分层内平衡);WTA<$102 这个条件是**随机化之后**用来界定 "impact evaluation sample" 的筛选条件。论文 intro 自己的简写("randomly assigned the 61 percent of these subjects with WTA less than $102")就是松的。61% 这个数字算术上成立:1,661/2,743 = 60.6%。

【合规率口径】修正前:"合规>90%"。修正后:">90 percent" 只出现在 intro;正文 Table 3 报的是 **"Share days deactivated" = 0.90(SD 0.29)**,Control 为 0.02。单位是**停用天数/抽查次数的占比,不是完全合规的人数占比**;SD 0.29 意味着有相当一部分 Treatment 组成员在不小比例的时间里重新激活了账号。正文另一处措辞为 "deactivated on 90 percent of checks between October 13th and November 7th"。即精确值是 0.90 而非严格 >0.90,且是 check 层面而非 person 层面。

【估计量类型】修正前:未限定,读作"停用四周使 SWB 改善 0.09 SD"。修正后:0.09 SD 是 **LATE(local average treatment effect)**,用 Treatment 指派 Ti 作工具变量对 Di(=抽查中被观测为停用的比例)做 2SLS(Equation 1),即"被 $102 报价诱导而停用者"的效应,既非 ITT 也非总体 ATE。且样本本身按 WTA<$102 筛选,即**相对不看重 Facebook 的人**。

【Bolier 基准的构念】修正前:"psychological interventions"(泛指心理干预/治疗)。修正后:引文本身逐字无误,但论文 intro 省掉了 "positive"——正文 Section 5 自己写的是 "**positive** psychology interventions (i.e., self-help therapy, group training, and individual therapy)",Bolier 2013 原标题即 "Positive Psychology Interventions"。基准是积极心理学自助类干预,不是针对临床抑郁的心理治疗。

【Bolier 基准本身的可靠性】修正前:把 0.34/0.23 SD 当作稳固参照,"25-40%" 因此读作"效应很小"。修正后:该基准已被一手证据削弱。(i) Bolier 2013 自陈 "indications for publication bias were found for all outcome measures",39 项研究中仅 1 项高质量、20 项低质量,I²=49.5%(SWB)/47.0%(抑郁)。(ii) White, Uttl & Holder 2019 (PLoS ONE 10.1371/journal.pone.0216588) 对 Bolier 做小样本偏倚校正后:抑郁 r=.11→**.02**、心理幸福感 r=.10→**.02**、主观幸福感 r=.17→.13。按校正后基准,0.09 SD 相对于 PPI 效应的占比**远高于 25-40%**(抑郁一支甚至反超),方向与"所以很小"的常见引用意图相反。

【SWB 内部测量不一致】需保留的限定语:紧邻 0.09 SD 那句之前,论文自己写 "Effects on subjective well-being as measured by responses to brief daily text messages are positive but **not significant**"(逐日短信实时测量点估计 0.01-0.06 SD)。显著的是回溯式 endline 问卷测量(life satisfaction 0.12、anxiety 0.10、depression 0.09、happiness 0.08 SD)。单引 0.09 SD 而丢掉这句,会掩盖"低回忆偏倚的高频测量未达显著"这一内部张力。

【成人样本的年龄结构】修正前:"成人样本非青少年"。修正后:方向完全成立(零青少年覆盖),但两点需补:(i) 入组规则是**出生年份 1900-2000**,不是"年满 18 岁";baseline 在 2018 年 9 月,2000 年下半年出生者当时可能仍为 17 岁——论文未报告年龄下限的实际执行。(ii) 该样本在成年人中**异常年轻**:Table 2 显示 impact evaluation sample 中 Age under 30 = **0.52**,而 Facebook 用户为 0.26、美国总人口为 0.21;中位年龄 31.5 岁。用于"青少年屏幕时间"语境时,这是一个偏年轻成人、且在成年人中不具代表性的样本。
evidence_notes: 一手 PDF 已下载并用 pdftotext 逐字提取,核了**两个版本**:(i) Stanford 工作论文版 https://web.stanford.edu/~gentzkow/research/facebook.pdf(2019-11-08);(ii) 已发表 AER 版 https://gwern.net/doc/sociology/technology/2020-allcott.pdf(AER vol.110 no.3, pp.629-676, 2020年3月, DOI 10.1257/aer.20190658)。两版关键措辞一致。

引语 (b) 逐字核对**成立**(两版一致,AER 版用 en-dash):"Our overall index of subjective well-being improved by 0.09 standard deviations. As a point of comparison, this is about 25–40 percent of the effect of psychological interventions including self-help therapy, group training, and individual therapy, as reported in a meta-analysis by Bolier et al. (2013)."(AER 版第 149-152 行)
引语 (c) 逐字核对**成立**(两版一致):"the magnitudes of our causal effects are far smaller than those we would have estimated using the correlational approach of much prior literature."(AER 版第 154-156 行)
"四周" 核实成立:摘要 "deactivating Facebook for the four weeks before the 2018 US midterm election";设计上 midline 后四周记为 "weeks 1-4",endline 后四周为 "weeks 5-8"。

AEARCTR-0003409 **核实成立**。socialscienceregistry.org/trials/3409:标题 "Evaluating Social Media",PI 含 Allcott/Braghieri/Eichmeyer/Gentzkow,干预期 2018-10-11 至 2018-12-06,计划样本 3,051,注册日 2018-10-11。附两版 pre-analysis plan(2018-10-12 与 2018-11-07 上传)。注意:注册日=干预起始日;第二版 PAP 于 11-07 上传,而 endline 邀请于 11-08 发出。论文中两处该编号亦逐字核对无误。

Figure 1 招募漏斗(工作论文第 1999-2013 行)逐行核对:N=1,892,191 曝光 → 32,201 点击 → 22,324 完成 pre-screen → 20,959 美国籍且生于 1900-2000 → 17,335 日均 FB 使用 15-600 分钟 → 7,455 同意 → 3,910 完成 baseline → **2,897 有效并被随机化** → 2,743 收到报价(其中 **1,661** 进入 impact evaluation sample)→ endline 完成 2,684(其中 1,637)→ post-endline 2,067(其中 1,219)。

Table 2 人口结构逐行核对(impact evaluation / Facebook 用户 / 美国总人口):Income under $50,000 0.40/0.41/0.42;College 0.51/0.33/0.29;Male 0.43/0.44/0.49;White 0.68/0.73/0.74;**Age under 30 0.52/0.26/0.21**;Republican 0.13/–/0.26;Democrat 0.42/–/0.20;Facebook minutes 74.52/45.00/–。另附录多处以 31.5 岁为该样本中位年龄做异质性切分。

Bolier 2013 原文核对(PMC3599475):SWB **d=0.34**、psychological well-being d=0.20、depression **d=0.23**,39 项研究/6,139 名参与者——Allcott 等对该 meta 的数值引用**准确**。但 Bolier 自陈:"no study met all of our quality criteria"(仅 1 项高质量、20 项低质量、18 项中等),I²=49.5%(SWB)/47.0%(抑郁),且 "indications for publication bias were found for all outcome measures"。人群含一般公众与有心理社会问题者。

反证/后续修正:White, Uttl & Holder 2019, PLoS ONE, "Meta-analyses of positive psychology interventions: The effects are much smaller than previously reported"(10.1371/journal.pone.0216588)对 Bolier 2013 与 Sin & Lyubomirsky 2009 做小样本偏倚校正。对 Bolier:SWB r=.17→.13、psychological well-being r=.10→.02、depression r=.11→.02;结论 PPI 对 well-being 的效应约 r=.10。这直接削弱了 "25-40%" 这一比较的分母。

估计量:Equation (1) Yi = τDi + ρȲbi + νs + εi,以 Ti 为 Di 的工具变量,"τ measures the local average treatment effect of deactivation for people induced to deactivate by the promised $102 payment"。正文明确 "In the body of the paper, we present figures with local average treatment effects and 95 percent confidence intervals"。基准样本为 impact evaluation sample。稳健标准误。

SWB 结果原文:"the largest and most significant effects on life satisfaction (0.12 SD), anxiety (0.10 SD), depression (0.09 SD), and happiness (0.08 SD)... The text message based measures of happiness are not significantly different from zero, with positive point estimates ranging from 0.01 SD to 0.06 SD. Deactivation improved our overall SWB index by 0.09 standard deviations." 多重假设检验用 Benjamini-Krieger-Yekutieli (2006) sharpened FDR。

利益相关核查:资助方为 Sloan Foundation 与 Knight Foundation(**非 Facebook 资助**)。披露声明原文:"Allcott is a paid employee of Microsoft Research. Gentzkow does paid consulting work for Amazon and is a member of the Toulouse Network for Information Technology, a research group funded by Microsoft. Braghieri and Eichmeyer have no relevant or material disclosures." 致谢名单含 Nancy Baym、Moira Burke、Annie Franco、Alex Leavitt(当时均为 Facebook 研究人员),且参考文献引用了 Baym 等 2019。招募通过付费 Facebook 展示广告(点击率 1.7%),未获 Facebook 内部数据。IRB:Stanford eProtocol #45403、NYU IRB-FY2018-2139。

corrections: 【最重要】N 的分母错位:『N=2,743』不是分析样本。修正前:『停用 Facebook 4 周、N=2,743』暗示效应估计基于 2,743 人。修正后:2,743 = midline 收到 BDM 报价的人数;真正的 impact evaluation sample(所有因果估计的基础)是 N=1,661(Treatment 580 + Control 1,081),完成 endline 的 N=1,637,post-endline 只剩 N=1,219。招募漏斗逐字为:32,201 点广告 → 22,324 完成预筛 → 20,959 美国+生于1900-2000 → 17,335 日均FB 15-600分钟 → 7,455 同意 → 3,910 完成baseline → 2,897 有效并被随机化 → 2,743 收到报价 → 1,661 进入影响评估样本。引用 0.09 SD 时应说 N≈1,637,不是 2,743。

合规率 >90% → 应为 =90%,且必须交代这是 IV 设计。修正前:『合规>90%』。修正后:正文导言确有逐字『the Treatment group's compliance with deactivation exceeded 90 percent』,但 Table 3 实测 Share of days deactivated = 0.90(SD 0.29),正文 §3 逐字为『Treatment group participants were deactivated on 90 percent of checks』;且 Control 组也有 2% 时间处于停用状态。作者明确写道『we will analyze the experiment as a randomized encouragement design』,主设定用 IV 而非 ITT。所以『高合规』不等于可当 ITT 读。

0.09 SD 的统计量身份缺失:它是 LATE 不是 ITT。修正前:『subjective well-being improved by 0.09 standard deviations』被当作『停用 Facebook 的效果』。修正后:逐字『τ measures the local average treatment effect of deactivation for people induced to deactivate by the promised $102 payment』——即被 102 美元诱导的 complier 的局部平均处理效应。Table A12 完整口径:效应 0.09,标准误 0.04,p=0.02,sharpened FDR q=0.03(通过多重检验校正,但显著性属边际)。

『25-40 percent』不是置信区间,是两个不同结局的比值区间。修正前:读作效应量的不确定性范围。修正后:它是 0.09 除以 Bolier 两个不同结局各自的效应:0.09/0.34(subjective well-being,不含抑郁)= 26%,0.09/0.23(depression)= 39%。已回溯 Bolier 2013 一手核实:39 项 RCT,SWB d=0.34 [95%CI 0.22, 0.45],psychological well-being d=0.20 [0.09, 0.30],depression d=0.23 [0.09, 0.38]。分子分母对得上。

该对标基准的分母本身脆弱,引用时应加限定。Bolier 2013 一手自陈:39 项研究中仅 1 项被评为高质量(Mitchell 2009),18 项中等、20 项低质量,平均质量分 2.56/6;仅 7/39 报告了充分的随机化隐藏,仅 3/39 做了 ITT 分析,0 项报告充分的检验效能分析;各结局均有『indications for publication bias』。Trim-and-fill 校正后 depression 效应从 0.23 降到 0.16 —— 若用校正值,比值变成 0.09/0.16 ≈ 56%,而非 39%。方向上这反而让停用 Facebook 的相对效应更大,但基准线本身建立在弱证据上。

(c) 的逐字引语正确但被截断,补全后语气有别。修正前:『the magnitudes of our causal effects are far smaller than those we would have estimated using the correlational approach』。修正后:原句完整为『However, we also show that the magnitudes of our causal effects are far smaller than those we would have estimated using the correlational approach of much prior literature.』引语部分逐字无误,只是止于 approach;补上 of much prior literature 才是完整句。正文量化支撑:基线相关 ≈0.23 SD vs 实验估计 0.09 SD,逐字『about three times larger』且『highly statistically significantly different』。

(d)『成人样本』成立但入选标准不是年龄 18+,且样本远非代表性成人。修正前:『成人样本非青少年』。修正后:预筛逐字为『a US resident born between the years 1900 and 2000』——是出生年份切口,不是显式 18 岁门槛(2018年9-12月实地期内,2000年末出生者可能仍为 17 岁)。确无青少年样本。但样本严重偏斜:Age under 30 占 0.52(FB 用户 0.26、美国成人 0.21),中位年龄 31.5 岁,College 0.51(美国 0.29),民主党 0.42 vs 共和党 0.13(美国 0.20/0.26),日均 FB 74.52 分钟(平均约 45 分钟)。应表述为『偏年轻、偏高学历、偏民主党、重度用户的成人自选样本』,且绝不可外推到青少年。

引文出处口径:URL 给的是工作论文不是 AER 发表版。修正前:标注为『2020 AER』并给 https://web.stanford.edu/~gentzkow/research/facebook.pdf。修正后:该 URL 实际提供的是 2019年11月8日 工作论文(Gentzkow 站点文件日期 2019-11-16),即 NBER WP 25514(2019年1月,2019年11月修订)。发表版为 American Economic Review 110(3): 629-76(2020年3月),DOI 10.1257/aer.20190658。AEA 页面摘要与工作论文摘要逐字一致,页面未列出任何 erratum,故实质无分歧,但上述所有正文数字均系对工作论文核对所得。
evidence_notes: 一手 PDF 已下载并用 pdftotext 全文提取(5,343 行),来源 https://web.stanford.edu/~gentzkow/research/facebook.pdf,版本页眉为 November 8, 2019。以下均为逐字比对。

(b) 引语逐字命中,导言原文:『Our overall index of subjective well-being improved by 0.09 standard deviations. As a point of comparison, this is about 25-40 percent of the effect of psychological interventions including self-help therapy, group training, and individual therapy, as reported in a meta-analysis by Bolier et al. (2013).』待验论断的省略号恰好覆盖『As a point of comparison, this is』,引用无失真。

正文 §5.3 第二处对应表述逐字:『a meta-analysis of 39 randomized evaluations finds that positive psychology interventions (i.e. self-help therapy, group training, and individual therapy) improve subjective well-being (excluding depression) by 0.34 standard deviations and reduce depression by 0.23 standard deviations (Bolier et al. 2013). Thus, deactivating Facebook increased our subjective well-being index by about 25-40 percent as much as standard psychological interventions.』注意此处限定语为 standard psychological interventions。

(a) 61% 与 $102 逐字命中导言:『We then randomly assigned the 61 percent of these subjects with WTA less than $102 to either a Treatment group that was paid to deactivate, or a Control group that was not.』算术自洽:1,661/2,743 = 60.6% ≈ 61%。注意随机化实为 baseline 阶段完成(N=2,897 were randomized),WTA<$102 是事后筛出分析样本;分组非对半,约 33% 获 p=$102、约 67% 获 p=$0,故 580 vs 1,081。

$102 的选择理由(脚注 11)逐字:『We chose $102 because our pilot data correctly suggested that there would be a point mass of WTAs at $100 and that it would maximize statistical power per dollar of cost』;$170 为上限因『it was the maximum that we could pay participants without requiring tax-related paperwork』。

Table 3(Survey Response and Treatment Compliance Rates)实测值:Completed endline survey 0.99/0.98;Share of text messages completed 0.92/0.93;Completed post-endline survey 0.95/0.92;Share days deactivated 0.90 (0.29) vs 0.02 (0.13),p=0.00;N = 580 / 1,081。

Table A12(Treatment Effects: Indices)完整口径,均为 LATE:Subjective well-being index 0.09,SE 0.04,p=0.02,sharpened FDR q=0.03。同表旁证:News knowledge index -0.19(p=0.00)、Political polarization index -0.16(p=0.00)、Post-experiment use index -0.61(p=0.00)。分项 SWB:life satisfaction 0.12 SD、anxiety 0.10 SD、depression 0.09 SD、happiness 0.08 SD;短信测量的 happiness 不显著(0.01-0.06 SD)。

(c) 相关 vs 因果的量化支撑,§5.3 逐字:『The baseline correlation between our SWB index and Facebook use is about three times larger than the experimental estimate of the treatment effect of deactivation (about 0.23 SD compared to 0.09 SD), and the point estimates are highly statistically significantly different.』且『Controlling for basic demographics brings down the non-experimental estimate somewhat, but it remains economically』显著。

AEARCTR-0003409 双向核实。论文致谢脚注逐字:『This RCT was registered in the American Economic Association Registry for randomized control trials under trial number AEARCTR-0003409.』注册库 https://www.socialscienceregistry.org/trials/3409 独立确认:标题 Evaluating Social Media,注册日 2018-10-11,干预期 2018-10-11 至 2018-12-06,PI 为 Allcott/Gentzkow/Braghieri/Eichmeyer/Bhargava,计划样本 3,051,状态 Completed(研究期 2018-09-24 至 2018-12-06)。计划 3,051 vs 实际随机化 2,897,略低于计划但同量级。

预分析计划的时间线可信(降低 p-hacking 疑虑),§4.1 逐字:PAP 提交于 10月12日『as this was the final day before the Treatment and Control groups could have begun to differ』,11月7日更新一处实质改动——改用 IV 而非 ITT 作为主设定,理由是观察到的不合规原因。属事前、有据的调整。

Bolier et al. 2013 一手核实(BMC Public Health 13(1):119,PMC3599475):39 项 RCT;SWB d=0.34 [0.22, 0.45];psychological well-being d=0.20 [0.09, 0.30];depression d=0.23 [0.09, 0.38]。质量警告一手自陈:『None of the studies met all quality criteria』,仅 1 项高质量,平均 2.56/6;I² 分别为 49.5%/29.0%/47.0%;各结局均有 publication bias 迹象,trim-and-fill 后 psychological well-being 与 depression 均降至 0.16。

发表版元数据核实(https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257/aer.20190658):American Economic Review 110(3), March 2020, 629-76,DOI 10.1257/aer.20190658;页面摘要与 2019 工作论文摘要逐字一致;页面未列 erratum 或 correction。NBER 页面(w25514)确认 January 2019, Revised November 2019,并注明后续发表于 AER 110(3):629-676。

Gentzkow does paid consulting work for Amazon and is a member of the Toulouse Network for Information Technology, a research group funded by Microsoft. Braghieri and Eichmeyer have no relevant or material disclosures.』致谢中 Nancy Baym、Moira Burke、Annie Franco、Alex Leavitt 为 Facebook 研究人员,但仅列为评论致谢,无资助、数据供给或发表审批权。IRB:Stanford eProtocol #45403、NYU IRB-FY2018-2139。结论:披露透明,不构成推翻性利益冲突,但『被批评对象的雇员参与评论』这一点在引用时值得一提。

作者自设的外推限制(脚注 23)逐字警告,可用于防止过度外推:『the treatment effects in our sample from a four-week deactivation are unlikely to generalize to the US population over Facebook's 15-year life』。另 §5.3 指出效应不随时间递增,『if anything, the point estimates are largest in the first week』,即『更长时间停用效应更大』没有证据支持。
